title: STEAM/VALVE DEVKIT PLAYBOOK — milkGate as Mobile Pipeline

kevin_touches_deck.summary: Kevin does 4 taps in Gaming Mode — NO Konsole, NO Desktop Mode needed
steps: 1. Settings > System > Enable Developer Mode → ON
2. Settings > Developer > Set User Password → pick any password (e.g. 'gaia')
3. Settings > Developer > Pair new host → tap this and WAIT
4. When milkGate sends pairing request → tap APPROVE
kevin_touches_deck.critical_note: SteamOS 3.8+ added 'Set User Password' in Developer Settings — NO KONSOLE NEEDED! This is the key that unlocks everything.

the_solved_problem.key_insight: The devkit pairing flow is DESIGNED for exactly this — a dev machine controls Steam hardware. We were trying to hack around it when we should have just USED it as intended.
the_solved_problem.what_kevin_touches: 4 taps per device: Dev Mode ON → Set Password → Pair New Host → Approve
the_solved_problem.what_gaia_does: EVERYTHING else — from milkGate: compile, deploy, launch, profile, manage
the_solved_problem.what_we_missed: SteamOS 3.8 added 'Set User Password' in Gaming Mode developer settings. Before that, you HAD to use Konsole. Now it's all touch.
